name: @faces-sh/cli
description: CLI for Faces: compile causal models from source texts, ask them what they would do, and chat with them on any model
author: Headwaters Lab Inc.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && oclif manifest && oclif readme

chat.description: Chat with a face on any chat model: @face:maestro-1/<model>

compile.description: Compile source texts into a face

style.description: Build and manage a face's styles

compile:doc.description: Documents: create, compile, edit, pause, reset and delete

compile:thread.description: Threads: create, compile, edit, replace, pause, reset and delete

group.description: Groups of faces that work together

user.description: Other users: profiles, followers and following

face:avatar.description: A face's picture: list, get, make, upload and delete

billing:subscription.description: Your plan: show, subscribe, switch and cancel

fidelity.description: Fidelity runs: start, turn, pick, read and save

benchmark.description: Compare a face against a reference model on its own material

state.description: States: the proof in progress your agent builds, kept on the server: goals, their refinement, tests and claims. state:create --use makes one for this directory

models.description: The models you can name, with their prices

premise.description: Premises in a state: add, edit, get, delete and claim them; refine, choices and decide ask a face
